description: Command-line and Node.js tool for the Mermaid library to generate SVG, PNG, or PDF files from Mermaid diagram definitions.
auth_notes: No authentication or API credentials required as it is a local command-line and Node.js package.
credential_notes: Open source tool available freely via npm or Docker without any account or API key requirements.
api_notes: Provides a local CLI command (mmdc) and a simple Node.js package function (run) to compile diagram text files into graphical formats.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by the vendor.
rationale: It is an open-source, locally executable CLI and Node.js tool that can be embedded directly into agent environments instantly without credentials.

evidence.note: Documentation shows it is a local CLI and Node.js package requiring no web API authentication.
Installation is completely open source via npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli or Docker with no account needed.
Exposes command line interface options (mmdc) and a Node.js run function.
